# Dyrn Zefanya

> IT and digital specialist in Jakarta, Indonesia. Eight years across IT
> infrastructure and digital marketing, five of them in WordPress, technical SEO
> and analytics for B2B industrial clients. Available for freelance website and
> SEO work, and open to full-time roles.

Site: https://dyrnzefanya.github.io/personal-site/
Contact: dryndarmawan@gmail.com

## What he does

- **Website development** — WordPress and Elementor, or Next.js and React. Delivered
  for factories, schools, SMEs and service businesses.
- **Technical SEO** — audits, on-page work, technical fixes, local SEO.
- **Analytics and reporting** — GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Search Console.
- **AI automation** — n8n workflows, MCP integrations, internal agents that remove
  recurring manual work.

## Verified results

- **busabunga.com** — built end to end in React; reached #1 and page-one Google
  positions for its target commercial keywords within about one month of its June 2026
  launch, on a brand-new domain with no backlinks and no ad budget.
- **Sekolah Trinitas** — #1 Google rankings for five competitive local keywords:
  sekolah kristen lampung, sekolah kristen terbaik lampung, sekolah trilingual terbaik
  lampung, sekolah trilingual lampung, sekolah kristen lampung paling bagus.
- **PT Tjikko Sentral Industrial** — roughly 40% growth in organic traffic and 25% more
  leads over four years, SEO-driven with no paid advertising. Wazuh SIEM across 50+
  devices cut downtime by about 30%.
- **Hermes AI Agent System** — self-hosted multi-agent stack on Claude API, n8n and MCP.
  A GA4 Daily Reporter runs in production across three properties.
